newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Monday amid position-squaring on clearing day, dealers said.
They said most blue chips gained, with few sellers in sight. Dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said many investors had had to buy at higher rates to square their positions.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 18.25 points, or 1.24 percent, to close at 1,494.74. Gainers led losers 149 to 102. PTCL rose 1.65 rupees to 32 rupees and Bank of Punjab 2.30 to 23.50. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192

Bank of Punjab rose 2.30 rupees to 23.50, Faysal Bank 0.25 to 24.15, Hub Power Co 0.70 to 37.90, Sui Northern Gas 1.25 to 37.50 and Pakistan State Oil 1.50 to 283.50. PTCL rose 1.65 to 32, ICI Pakistan 0.50 to 19.40 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.20 to 14.90.
